product.title: Half-Day Glacier National Park Whitewater Rafting Adventure

description.text: Paddle through calm stretches of the Middle Fork Flathead River before entering John Stevens Canyon for a series of beginner-friendly Class II and III rapids. A professional guide leads your raft from Great Northern Resort with all safety gear included, making this a popular half-day introduction to Glacier country river running.

highlights: Beginner-friendly whitewater on the Middle Fork Flathead River
Professional guide and full rafting safety equipment included
Morning and afternoon departures from West Glacier
Scenic float sections paired with John Stevens Canyon rapids
Family-owned Great Northern Resort river outfitter

start.description: Meet at Great Northern Resort, 12127 US-2, West Glacier, MT 59936. Arrive 30 minutes before your scheduled trip for check-in and safety briefing.

end.description: Return to Great Northern Resort after the river take-out shuttle.

product.itinerarySummary: Paddle through calm stretches of the Middle Fork Flathead River before entering John Stevens Canyon for a series of beginner-friendly Class II and III rapids.

itineraryItems.title: Middle Fork Flathead River
itineraryItems.description: Launch on the Middle Fork Flathead River bordering Glacier National Park for a guided warm-up paddle.

itineraryItems.title: John Stevens Canyon
itineraryItems.description: Navigate Class II and III rapids through John Stevens Canyon with guide-led paddling commands.

itineraryItems.title: West Glacier
itineraryItems.description: Shuttle back to the Great Northern Resort base near the Going-to-the-Sun Road junction.
